Parent epic: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/110

## Scope and completion evidence
Inventory Foundation objectives and prerequisites, especially pseudocode, numbers/bits, logic and game maths. Sample and test examples. Find misconceptions, gaps and cross-system dependencies. Prototype predict/explain/modify/debug/create assessments that require genuine understanding rather than copying. Report editorial, technical and actual learner-testing evidence separately; prioritise bounded fixes.

## Done when
- Results and source/version/environment identities are recorded, with passed/failed/skipped/unknown distinguished.
- Findings are filed as specific follow-up issues or linked to existing ones; no duplicate implementation plan.
- Reviewed findings, limits and next bounded step are linked from this issue.

Maintain existing product architecture and avoid broad rewrites.
title: [Education] Audit shared Foundations for conceptual accuracy and transferable understanding
